kind: analyze (nonperturbative dielectric function of natural-abundance BAs at 300 K from an N = 256 fixed-count isotope ensemble on the staged harmonic force constants; feature spacings, signs, orderings, ensemble convergence and strength moments)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L2/result.json (guards G1, G2, G3, G6, G7 and metrics M1, M2; block statistics runs/nat_blocks/block_stats_iso.json, 39 disjoint blocks of 256 configurations; commit 1ccd851 and later). Tolerances: the block-derived set proposed in result.json and accepted by reviewer on 2026-09-10. The staged file agent/ifc_harmonic_512.npz is L1's deliverable unchanged (sha256 fd63e55687a26d8b26bad1462f1d3eebd27d364371d8dc7d29cd104f0215407e). Reference submission: complete independent N=256 ensemble runs/reference_corrected_n256 (seed 924071835), full 0.01 cm^-1 grid, both spectra and per-configuration moduli retained; every reference field re-extracted from that same calculation. Corrected 39-block RSE statistics in runs/nat_blocks/corrected_rse_stats.json are 0.02 cm^-1 diagnostics, not the full task reference.

omega_TO_vc_cm1.rule: within 0.1 cm^-1 of ours (deterministic on the staged file: the optically active zone-centre mode of the uniform-mass supercell; a sanity check on the mass and unit chain, not a ruled guard)

G1_eps2_spacing.rule: eps2_max_above_710_cm1 - eps2_max_below_710_cm1 within 19.96 +/- 2.0 (39 blocks 20.13 +/- 0.30, range 19.49-20.76, margin >= 1.20 cm^-1 = four block standard deviations; the alternative reading that takes the pure-limit splitting 29.4 cm^-1 still fails)

G6_eps2_isotope_ordering.rule: the dominant feature (the larger of the two eps'' values) is the one below 710 and lies within 10 cm^-1 of our pure-11B TO 691.1701, and the other lies within 10 cm^-1 of our pure-10B TO 720.5293 (ordering exact in 39 of 39 blocks; worst block margin 2.42 cm^-1 on the bump, eight block standard deviations)

G2_eps1_spacing.rule: eps1_min_above_max_cm1 - eps1_max_700_740_cm1 within 5.77 +/- 2.5 (39 blocks 5.65 +/- 0.41, range 5.01-6.48; the independent N = 256 validation ensemble reads 4.71, below the block range, so the +/- 2.0 cut from the blocks was widened to 2.5 at authoring (edge 3.27, 5.8 block sigma below the block mean); the alternative pairing of the main resonance's peak and valley (2.5 cm^-1) still fails. The dip is a shallow shoulder, the widest-spread feature in the leaf)

G3_sign_of_min_eps1.rule: min_eps1_disordered_680_740 > 0 and min_eps1_baseline_680_740 < 0 (sign only: under a positive common strength scaling, min eps' is affine because eps_inf stays fixed; magnitudes are not matched; positive in 39 of 39 blocks, block minimum 1.7455, fourteen block standard deviations above zero)

G7_ensemble_convergence.rule: rse_max_xx_percent within the unchanged [1.63, 6.52] percent band. Definition: sample standard error of abs(eps_xx) divided by mean(abs(eps_xx)), maximum over 680–740 cm^-1. Corrected 39 disjoint N=256 blocks on the legacy 0.02 grid: mean 2.950864%, sample SD 0.115483%, range 2.754058–3.173963%; pooled N=9984 gives 0.457919%. These are stopping-grid diagnostics. The full 0.01-grid reference gives 2.829815%. The accepted bounds are retained, not rescaled from the corrected mean; the historical N=64 estimate passes and N=1024 estimate fails.

not_graded.eps2_max_below_710_value, eps2_max_above: recorded; used only to decide which of the two features is the dominant one for G6
not_graded.absolute_feature_frequencies: our frequencies run about 6-7 cm^-1 below the paper's (the virtual-crystal offset, L2 result.json); only spacings and positions relative to our own TO frequencies are graded
not_graded.paper_precision_criterion: the paper's 0.32 % standard error at 10 000 configurations is recorded, never graded
not_graded.Tamura_isotope_linewidth: never added to gamma (reviewer ruling 2026-09-05); an agent that added a golden-rule isotope width would broaden the baseline and shift the features

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)
